schema:
datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

model User {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid())
  userIdentifier String?   @unique
  name           String
  email          String    @unique
  phone          String?
  passwordHash   String
  status         String    @default("ACTIVE")
  lastLoginAt    DateTime?

  mustChangePassword Boolean @default(false)
  activeSessionId    String?

  createdBy       String?
  approvedBy      String?
  approvedAt      DateTime?
  rejectionReason String?

  // 1. Personal Information
  profileImageUrl  String?
  secondaryPhone   String?
  whatsappNumber   String?
  currentAddress   String?
  permanentAddress String?
  bloodGroup       String?
  socialMedia      Json?

  // 2. Identification Details
  panNumber     String?
  aadhaarNumber String?

  // 3. Banking Details
  bankName      String?
  accountNumber String?
  ifscCode      String?
  branchName    String?

  // 4. Emergency Contact Information
  emergencyContactName     String?
  emergencyContactRelation String?
  emergencyContactPhone    String?

  // 5. Official Details
  jobTitle             String?
  department           String?
  workLocation         String?
  dateOfJoining        DateTime?
  designation          String?
  commissionPercentage Float?

  roleId String
  role   Role   @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id])

  parentId String?
  parent   User?   @relation("UserHierarchy", fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  children User[]  @relation("UserHierarchy")

  teamId String?
  team   Team?   @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id])

  bookings               Booking[]
  commissionPolicies     CommissionPolicy[]
  commissionTransactions CommissionTransaction[]

  teamRequestsMade     TeamRequest[] @relation("TeamRequester")
  teamRequestsTargeted TeamRequest[] @relation("TeamRequestTarget")
  teamRequestsProposed TeamRequest[] @relation("TeamRequestProposedParent")

  siteVisits     SiteVisit[]
  demoBookings   DemoBooking[]
  reviewRequests ReviewRequest[]
  notifications  Notification[]

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Role {
  id          String  @id @default(uuid())
  name        String  @unique // MD, ASSOCIATE_MANAGER, ASSOCIATE
  description String?

  users       User[]
  permissions Permission[] @relation("RolePermissions")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Permission {
  id          String  @id @default(uuid())
  name        String  @unique // e.g. "view:leads", "manage:users"
  description String?

  roles Role[] @relation("RolePermissions")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Team {
  id         String  @id @default(uuid())
  name       String
  headUserId String?

  users User[]

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model TeamRequest {
  id          String @id @default(uuid())
  requesterId String
  requester   User   @relation("TeamRequester", fields: [requesterId], references: [id])

  targetUserId String
  targetUser   User   @relation("TeamRequestTarget", fields: [targetUserId], references: [id])

  proposedParentId String?
  proposedParent   User?   @relation("TeamRequestProposedParent", fields: [proposedParentId], references: [id])

  requestType String // ADD, REMOVE
  reason      String? @db.Text
  status      String  @default("PENDING") // PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED

  reviewedBy      String?
  reviewedAt      DateTime?
  rejectionReason String?   @db.Text

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Project {
  id                 String  @id @default(uuid())
  code               String  @unique
  name               String
  description        String? @db.Text
  location           String
  projectType        String // e.g. "RESIDENTIAL", "COMMERCIAL"
  status             String  @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT, SUBMITTED, PENDING_APPROVAL, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, ARCHIVED
  verificationStatus String  @default("UNVERIFIED") // UNVERIFIED, VERIFIED, REJECTED
  isFeatured         Boolean @default(false)
  isHot              Boolean @default(false)

  createdBy       String
  approvedBy      String?
  approvedAt      DateTime?
  rejectionReason String?

  developerName       String?
  marketingCompany    String?
  possessionDate      DateTime?
  locationDetails     Json?
  legalInfo           Json?
  landDetails         Json?
  pricingInfo         Json?
  amenities           Json?
  nearbyInfo          Json?
  constructionDetails Json?
  marketingInfo       Json?
  salesInfo           Json?

  media                  ProjectMedia[]
  inventory              InventoryUnit[]
  carouselItems          CarouselItem[]
  promotionalPopups      PromotionalPopup[]
  bookings               Booking[]
  commissionPolicies     CommissionPolicy[]
  commissionTransactions CommissionTransaction[]
  siteVisits             SiteVisit[]
  demoBookings           DemoBooking[]
  offers                 Offer[]
  reviewRequests         ReviewRequest[]
  layouts                ProjectLayout[]

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model ProjectMedia {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId    String
  project      Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  mediaType    String // e.g. "GALLERY", "BROCHURE", "LAYOUT"
  url          String
  title        String?
  displayOrder Int      @default(0)
  status       String   @default("ACTIVE")
  isCover      Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
}

model InventoryUnit {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  projectId    String
  project      Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  unitNumber   String
  propertyType String // e.g. "PLOT", "UNIT"
  size         String?
  price        Decimal
  status       String  @default("AVAILABLE") // AVAILABLE, BOOKED, BLOCKED

  // Specific Fields (Plots & Apartments)
  facing          String?
  shape           String?
  area            Float?
  roadInformation String?
  northBoundary   String?
  southBoundary   String?
  eastBoundary    String?
  westBoundary    String?
  northLength     Float?
  southLength     Float?
  eastLength      Float?
  westLength      Float?
  towerBlock      String?
  floor           String?

  metadata       Json?
  booking        Booking?
  layoutElements LayoutElement[]

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([projectId, unitNumber]) // Prevent duplicate unit names in the same project
}

model CarouselItem {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  title        String?
  subtitle     String?
  imageUrl     String
  ctaLabel     String?
  ctaTargetUrl String?

  projectId String?
  project   Project? @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  status       String    @default("ACTIVE") // ACTIVE, INACTIVE
  displayOrder Int       @default(0)
  startAt      DateTime?
  endAt        DateTime?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model PromotionalPopup {
  id           String  @id @default(uuid())
  heading      String
  description  String? @db.Text
  imageUrl     String?
  ctaLabel     String?
  ctaTargetUrl String?

  projectId String?
  project   Project? @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  status  String    @default("ACTIVE") // ACTIVE, INACTIVE
  startAt DateTime?
  endAt   DateTime?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Booking {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  userId String
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  projectId String
  project   Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  inventoryUnitId String        @unique
  inventoryUnit   InventoryUnit @relation(fields: [inventoryUnitId], references: [id])

  // Customer Details
  customerName      String
  customerPhone     String
  alternatePhone    String?
  customerEmail     String?
  customerAddress   String? @db.Text
  preferredLocation String?

  // Financial & Booking Details
  bookingDate    DateTime
  expectedAmount Decimal
  paymentMode    String
  bookingAmount  Decimal
  notes          String?  @db.Text
  documents      Json? // Array of file URLs/metadata

  // State Machine
  status String @default("SUBMITTED") // SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, VERIFIED, REJECTED, PAYMENT_PENDING, CANCELLED

  // Verification
  verifiedBy      String?
  verifiedAt      DateTime?
  rejectionReason String?   @db.Text

  createdAt             DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime               @updatedAt
  commissionTransaction CommissionTransaction?
  reviewRequest         ReviewRequest?
}

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  actor      String // "SYSTEM" or user ID
  action     String // e.g., "CREATE_BOOKING", "UPDATE_INVENTORY_STATUS", "VERIFY_BOOKING"
  entity     String // e.g., "Booking", "InventoryUnit"
  entityId   String
  beforeJson Json?
  afterJson  Json?
  metadata   Json? // e.g., IP address, session ID, user agent
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
}

model CommissionPolicy {
  id     String @id @default(uuid())
  userId String
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  projectId String?
  project   Project? @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  type  String // PERCENTAGE or FIXED
  value Decimal

  status String @default("PENDING_APPROVAL") // PENDING_APPROVAL, ACTIVE, INACTIVE

  createdBy       String
  approvedBy      String?
  approvedAt      DateTime?
  rejectionReason String?   @db.Text

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([userId, projectId]) // A user can have one policy per project, or one global (null project)
}

model CommissionTransaction {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  bookingId String  @unique
  booking   Booking @relation(fields: [bookingId], references: [id])

  userId String
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  projectId String
  project   Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  commissionType  String // snapshot: PERCENTAGE or FIXED
  commissionValue Decimal // snapshot: value from policy
  baseAmount      Decimal // snapshot: booking amount

  amountCalculated Decimal
  amountReceived   Decimal @default(0)
  amountDue        Decimal

  status String @default("PENDING") // PENDING, PARTIAL, RECEIVED

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model SiteVisit {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  projectId String
  project   Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  customerName  String
  customerPhone String
  customerEmail String?

  isDemo Boolean @default(false)

  visitDate DateTime
  visitTime String

  status String @default("SCHEDULED") // SCHEDULED, ON_THE_WAY, ARRIVED, CUSTOMER_MET, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, RESCHEDULED

  outcome          String?   @db.Text
  followUpRequired Boolean   @default(false)
  followUpDate     DateTime?
  remarks          String?   @db.Text

  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  completedAt   DateTime?
  cancelledAt   DateTime?
  rescheduledAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([projectId])
  @@index([visitDate])
  @@index([status])
}

model DemoBooking {
  id        String  @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  projectId String
  project   Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])

  customerName  String
  customerPhone String
  customerEmail String?

  scheduledDate DateTime
  scheduledTime String

  status String @default("SCHEDULED") // SCHEDULED, CONDUCTED, CANCELLED, RESCHEDULED

  outcome          String?   @db.Text
  followUpRequired Boolean   @default(false)
  followUpDate     DateTime?
  remarks          String?   @db.Text

  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  completedAt   DateTime?
  cancelledAt   DateTime?
  rescheduledAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([projectId])
  @@index([scheduledDate])
  @@index([status])
}

model Offer {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid())
  title          String
  description    String?   @db.Text
  targetAudience String // e.g. "ASSOCIATE", "CUSTOMER", "ALL"
  projectId      String?
  project        Project?  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  targetBookings Int?
  reward         String?   @db.Text
  startDate      DateTime?
  endDate        DateTime?
  status         String    @default("ACTIVE") // ACTIVE, INACTIVE, EXPIRED, SCHEDULED, ARCHIVED

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([targetAudience])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([projectId])
}

model ReviewRequest {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  token              String   @unique
  userId             String
  user               User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  projectId          String
  project            Project  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  bookingId          String   @unique
  booking            Booking  @relation(fields: [bookingId], references: [id])
  customerName       String
  customerPhone      String
  customerEmail      String?
  requestDate        DateTime @default(now())
  interactionSummary String?  @db.Text
  status             String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING, SUBMITTED

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  review Review?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([projectId])
}

model Review {
  id                 String        @id @default(uuid())
  reviewRequestId    String        @unique
  reviewRequest      ReviewRequest @relation(fields: [reviewRequestId], references: [id])
  overallExperience  Int
  communication      Int
  propertyExperience Int
  associateSupport   Int
  writtenReview      String?       @db.Text

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Notification {
  id         String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  user       User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  category   String // Booking, Project, Commission, Travel, Team, Approval, Offer, Site Visit, Review, System
  title      String
  message    String    @db.Text
  entityType String?
  entityId   String?
  actionUrl  String?
  eventKey   String? // Deterministic identifier for duplicate prevention (e.g. BOOKING_VERIFIED_123)
  isRead     Boolean   @default(false)
  readAt     DateTime?
  isDismissed Boolean  @default(false)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isRead])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([eventKey])
}

model Faq {
  id             String  @id @default(uuid())
  question       String  @db.Text
  answer         String  @db.Text
  category       String
  roleVisibility Json // Array of allowed roles, e.g. ["MD", "ASSOCIATE"]
  isPublished    Boolean @default(true)
  displayOrder   Int     @default(0)

  relatedTutorialSlug String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([category])
  @@index([isPublished])
}

model Tutorial {
  id             String  @id @default(uuid())
  title          String
  slug           String  @unique
  category       String
  description    String? @db.Text
  roleVisibility Json // Array of allowed roles
  isPublished    Boolean @default(true)
  displayOrder   Int     @default(0)

  steps TutorialStep[]

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([category])
  @@index([isPublished])
}

model TutorialStep {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  tutorialId String
  tutorial   Tutorial @relation(fields: [tutorialId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  stepNumber     Int
  title          String
  explanation    String  @db.Text
  targetSelector String? // CSS selector for the DOM element to highlight (optional)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([tutorialId, stepNumber])
}

model ProjectLayout {
  id                String  @id @default(uuid())
  projectId         String
  project           Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id])
  name              String // e.g. "Ground Floor", "Block A", "Master Layout"
  version           String  @default("v1")
  status            String  @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT, PUBLISHED, ARCHIVED
  canvasWidth       Int     @default(3000)
  canvasHeight      Int     @default(3000)
  backgroundImage   String?
  backgroundOpacity Float   @default(1.0)
  gridSize          Int     @default(20)

  createdBy   String?
  updatedBy   String?
  publishedBy String?
  publishedAt DateTime?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  elements LayoutElement[]

  @@index([projectId])
}

model LayoutElement {
  id       String        @id @default(uuid())
  layoutId String
  layout   ProjectLayout @relation(fields: [layoutId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  type            String // PLOT, ROAD, AMENITY, TEXT, etc.
  inventoryUnitId String? // Link to existing InventoryUnit
  inventoryUnit   InventoryUnit? @relation(fields: [inventoryUnitId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  x        Float
  y        Float
  width    Float?
  height   Float?
  rotation Float  @default(0)
  zIndex   Int    @default(1)

  elementData Json? // Custom properties (points, color, labels, road type, plot facing)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([layoutId])
}
